rules.title: Massachusetts rent-control ballot question (IP 25-21)
rules.requirement: A ballot question that would have limited annual rent increases was struck by the Supreme Judicial Court and cannot go forward.
rules.quoted_span: The state's Supreme Judicial Court ruled a ballot question seeking to bring rent control back to Massachusetts cannot go forward this November, because it includes a religious exemption.
